Ghostty: Surface-centered sessions
|-- App [src/App.zig] - shared session coordinator
|   |-- surfaces: registered *apprt.Surface; focused_surface: checked reference
|   |-- mailbox -> tick / drainMailbox / surfaceMessage
|   |   `-- validate registration -> Surface.handleMessage -> runtime UI actions
|   |-- font_grid_set: font.SharedGridSet - shared, reference-counted grids
|   |-- device: ?*renderer.Device - lazily created; borrowed by renderers
|   `-- deinit: runtime surfaces first, then shared fonts and GPU device
|-- apprt.App [src/apprt.zig] - native UI/action boundary
|   `-- Host determines windows, tabs, splits and panes; delivers callbacks
`-- apprt.Surface - runtime wrapper, holds/manages a core Surface
    `-- Surface [src/Surface.zig] - one terminal widget and PTY session
        |-- app / rt_app / rt_surface: references, not owned subcomponents
        |-- config: owned DerivedConfig
        |   `-- updateConfig -> derived settings to I/O and renderer
        |-- keyboard / mouse / size / focused / visible / child_exited / readonly
        |-- Input callbacks: keyCallback / textCallback / mouseButtonCallback
        |   |-- performBindingAction -> local operation or rt_app.performAction
        |   |-- encodeKey -> input.key_encode.encode, using terminal modes
        |   |-- Mouse reports / paste -> protocol-aware encoders
        |   `-- queueIo owns messages; readonly discards writes -> io.queueMessage
        |-- sizeCallback -> resize: pixels + cell metrics + padding -> Size.grid
        |   |-- queueIo(.resize) -> io_thread coalesces -> io.resize
        |   `-- ALSO renderer_thread mailbox .resize + wakeup (direct path)
        |-- io: termio.Termio - owns session state and transport [I/O detail]
        |   |-- terminal: terminal.Terminal [src/terminal/Terminal.zig]
        |   |   |-- Geometry / tabstops / modes / colors / title / pwd / cursor style
        |   |   `-- screens: ScreenSet [src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig]
        |   |       |-- primary Screen; alternate Screen allocated on demand
        |   |       |   |-- cursor / saved_cursor / selection / charset / kitty_keyboard
        |   |       |   |-- kitty_images / semantic_prompt / dirty
        |   |       |   `-- pages: PageList [src/terminal/PageList.zig]
        |   |       |       |-- Ordered pages: history through active screen
        |   |       |       |   `-- Rows and cells [src/terminal/page.zig]
        |   |       |       `-- Tracked pins: viewport, cursor and selection locations
        |   |       `-- active: *Screen -> selected owned screen (not another copy)
        |   |-- terminal_stream: Stream(StreamHandler) - parser and handler state
        |   |-- backend: Backend.exec -> Exec -> subprocess / PTY
        |   `-- mailbox + derived I/O config
        |-- io_thread: termio.Thread + io_thr: OS thread (Surface-owned peers of io)
        |   `-- drainMailbox -> io.queueWrite; coalesced resize -> io.resize
        |-- renderer_state: renderer.State [src/renderer/State.zig]
        |   |-- terminal: pointer to io.terminal, NOT another emulator
        |   |-- mutex protects referenced data, preedit and render-relevant mouse state
        |   `-- lockDemand / unlockDemand / yieldToDemand: anti-starvation handoff
        |-- renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI) [renderer detail]
        |   |-- terminal_state: terminal.RenderState - render snapshot, not emulator
        |   `-- borrows App.device and font grid held via Surface.font_grid_key
        |-- renderer_thread: renderer.Thread + renderer_thr: OS thread
        |   `-- wakeups / timers -> renderer.updateFrame / drawFrame
        |-- draw -> renderer.drawFrame(true), also callable on main thread
        |-- Optional search worker and inspector
        `-- Lifecycle methods
            |-- init constructs resources, then starts renderer and I/O threads
            |-- childExited: native UI or terminal text; normal exit obeys wait_after_command
            |   `-- Abnormal short-lived exit reports error and holds instead of auto-close
            |-- close -> rt_surface.close(needsConfirmQuit()) -> runtime teardown
            `-- deinit: stop search; join renderer, then I/O (including PTY reader)
                `-- Free renderer before manager; free I/O, input, mutex, font ref, config
